name: ComputerMinds tools
description: A grab-bag of ComputerMinds site-builder and developer tools: a token-gated uptime-monitoring endpoint, a Paragraphs-as-table field formatter and widget, a Webform page-level validation handler, a session cache context, an update-report security sort, and static array/translation helpers.

suggests.drupal/paragraphs: Required for the Paragraphs table field formatter and widget.
suggests.drupal/webform: Required for the Page level validation webform handler.
